secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key used by the quickstart chat agent (platform.openai.com/api-keys). Without it the UI loads but chatting returns a message that the key is missing.

secrets.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Coinbase Developer Platform secret API key ID (portal.cdp.coinbase.com > API keys) used to create the agent's EVM wallet.

secrets.name: CDP_API_KEY_SECRET
secrets.description: Coinbase Developer Platform secret API key secret, paired with CDP_API_KEY_ID.

secrets.name: CDP_WALLET_SECRET
secrets.description: CDP wallet secret (portal.cdp.coinbase.com > Wallets) that lets the agent sign with its server wallet.
